Standard Requirements:

(APO)/Accredited Integrated Professional Organization (AIPO)

Situational Requirements:
[A. For Initial Accreditation]

(1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)

description of such work experience. (Affix two (2) documentary stamp tax)

compliance with the required Competency Area

area of studies

educational institution the CPA applicant is currently teaching

Competency Area, including 12 units of professional education units
(1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Professional Regulation Commission -

full_entry_text:
Application for Issuance of Certificate of Accreditation of Individual Certified Public Accountant (CPA) engaged in the practice of Public Accountancy
This service refers to the process of conferring a certificate of accreditation to an Individual Certified Public Accountant (CPA) engaged in the practice of Public Accountancy, and renewal of accreditation thereafter.

Office/Division: Central Office - Accreditation and Compliance Division
Classification: Complex
Type of Transaction: G2C (Government to Citizen)
Who may avail: Individual Certified Public Accountants
Operating Hours: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Standard Requirements:
- 1. Valid Professional Identification Card (PIC)
Professional Identification Card - Professional Regulation Commission
- 2. Pictures of Principal office
(1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 3. Duly accomplished Quality Accreditation Checklist prescribed in Board Resolution No.
2016-05
(1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 4. Proof of 120 Continuing Professional Development (CPD) credit units earned showing
compliance with the required Competency Area
(1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Professional Regulation Commission -
Continuing Professional Development Division)
- 5. Certificate of Membership in Good Standing
(1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Accredited Professional
Organization/Accredited Integrated
Professional Organization - Administrative
Division)
- 6. Documentary Stamp Tax (Php 30.00)
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Bureau of Internal Revenue - Revenue District
Office)

Situational Requirements:
[A. For Initial Accreditation]
- A.1. Certified true copy of Certificate of Registration as a Certified Public Accountant (CPA)
(1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Professional Regulation Commission -
Licensure and Registration Division)
- A.2. Duly signed Code of Good Governance of the Individual CPA
(1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- A.3. Duly signed copy of Internal quality review procedures
(1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- A.4. Certified true copy of Certificate of Registration
(1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Quality Assurance Review (QAR) Office -
Administrative Division)
- A.5. Duly signed Ethical and technical standards required of the practice of Public
Accountancy
(1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- A.6. Duly notarized Sworn statement by the CPA, with Documentary Stamp Tax on the
original copy
(1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Stating the following:
Has a meaningful participation in their respective internal quality review process;
Has undergone adequate and effective training (from organizations duly accredited by the Board or by its duly authorized
representatives) on all the current accounting and auditing standards, code of ethics, laws and their implementing rules and regulations,
circulars, memoranda, their respective codes of good governance and other related documents that are required in the practice of
Public Accountancy to ensure professional, ethical and technical standards;
He/she is of good moral character;
He/she had not been found guilty by a competent court and/or administrative body of any case involving moral turpitude and/or
unethical practices; and
Had at least three (3) years of meaningful experience in any of the areas of public practice including taxation as defined in Section 28
(A), Rule 4 of the Implementing Rules and Regulations of Republic Act (R.A.) No. 9298.
- A.7. CPA Integrity Pledge
(1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- A.8. Detailed description of work experience
(1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
To include the name of the company, position, duties and responsibilities and date of employment.
[B. For Renewal of Accreditation]
- B.1. Certificate of Accreditation
(1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Professional Regulation Commission -
Accreditation and Compliance Division)
- B.2. Certified true copy of any of the Quality Assurance Review (QAR) Office issued
documents
(1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Quality Assurance Review (QAR) Office -
Administrative Division)
  Note: Remarks:
Certificate of Registration, if the applicant is not yet subjected to QAR; or
Provisional Certificate of QAR Compliance, if the applicant is undergoing remediation process; or
Certificate of QAR Compliance, if the applicant has satisfactorily passed the QAR inspection or has completed and complied with all the
findings and recommendations of the QAR Inspection Team.
[C. For Government Employees (For Initial and Renewal of Accreditation)]
- C.1. Authority to practice the profession
(1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Issued by the employer and printed in the official letterhead of the institution/agency.

full_entry_text:
Application for Issuance of Certificate of Accreditation to Professional Organization (APO)/Integrated Professional Organization (AIPO)
This service refers to the process of conferring a certificate of accreditation to a Professional Organization (APO)/Integrated Professional Organization (AIPO), and renewal of accreditation thereafter.

Office/Division: Central Office - Accreditation and Compliance Division
Classification: Highly Technical
Type of Transaction: G2B (Government to Business)
Who may avail: Professional Organizations
Operating Hours: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Standard Requirements:
- 1. Secretary’s Certificate or Board Resolution granting authority to the National President
(1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Granting authority to:
Sign the petition;
Attest the completeness/authenticity of the documents submitted; and
Transact with the Professional Regulatory Board and the Professional Regulation Commission.
- 2. Complete List of Incumbent Officers, including its Chapter Officers, if any
(1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
The list must indicate the valid Professional Identification Cards (PICs) in the following format:
NAME POSITION LICENSE NO. VALIDITY OF PIC
- 3. Secretary’s Certificate of no intra-corporate/association dispute pending before the courts or
quasi-judicial bodies
(1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 4. Complete List of Members in Good Standing
(1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
With the following details:
Names of members in alphabetical order and numbered;
Their respective license numbers;
Dates of registration; and
Status of PICs, whether valid or expired.
- 5. Documentary Stamp Tax (Php 30.00)
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Bureau of Internal Revenue - Revenue District
Office)

Situational Requirements:
[A. For Initial Accreditation]
- A.1. Duly notarized Petition for Accreditation with verification, signed by the National
President
(1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Professional Regulation Commission -
Accreditation and Compliance Division)
- A.2. Authenticated copy of Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) issued documents
(1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Securities and Exchange Commission -
Extension Office)
  Note: Remarks:
Certificate of Registration;
Current Articles of Incorporation (For AIPO, its Articles of Incorporation shall include as one of its purposes to integrate the
professionals into one (1) National Organization as mandated by the Professional Regulatory Law (PRL));
Current By-Laws; and
Latest Audited Financial Statement/s (AFS), duly signed by a Certified Public Accountant (CPA) authorized to practice Public
Accountancy, including those of its Chapter Organizations, if applicable.
- A.3. Authenticated copy of Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) issued documents
(1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Bureau of Internal Revenue - Revenue District
Office)
  Note: Remarks:
Certificate of Registration; and
Tax Clearance.
- A.4. Work plan for two (2) years
(1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- A.5. Proof of payment of the prescribed processing fee
(1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Professional Regulation Commission -
Accreditation and Compliance Division)
  Note: Remarks:
Forms/Template: (APO - Annex “J” / AIPO - Annex “K”)
https://prc.gov.ph/acd-resolutions-and-issuances
[B. For Renewal of Accreditation]
- B.1. Duly notarized Petition for Renewal of Accreditation, signed by the National President
(1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Professional Regulation Commission -
Accreditation and Compliance Division)
  Note: Remarks:
Stating among others, the following:
It continues to maintain the purpose/s for which it was established; and
Its membership does not fall below fifty percent plus one (50%+1) of the registered professionals with valid Professional Identification
Cards (PICs) for the current year for accreditation.
Forms/Template: (APO - Annex “D” / AIPO - Annex “F”)
https://prc.gov.ph/acd-resolutions-and-issuances
- B.2. Authenticated copy of Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) issued documents
(1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Securities and Exchange Commission -
Extension Office)
  Note: Remarks:
Amended Articles of Incorporation;
Amended By-Laws; and
Latest Audited Financial Statement/s (AFS), duly signed by a Certified Public Accountant (CPA) authorized to practice Public
Accountancy.
If no changes in the organization, submit affidavit of no amendments (Articles of Incorporation and By-Laws) to be executed by the Corporate
Secretary.
- B.3. Authenticated copy of Tax Clearance
(1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Bureau of Internal Revenue - Revenue District
Office)
- B.4. Proof of payment of the prescribed processing fee
(1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Professional Regulation Commission -
Accreditation and Compliance Division)
  Note: Remarks:
Forms/Template: (APO - Annex “L” / AIPO - Annex “M”)
https://prc.gov.ph/acd-resolutions-and-issuances

Application for Issuance of Certificate of Compliance for Mechanical Engineering Work, Project, Plant, and Establishment
This service refers to the process of conferring a certificate of compliance to a Mechanical Engineering Work, Project, Plant, and Establishment.

https://prc.gov.ph/acd-resolutions-and-issuances

Office/Division: Central Office - Accreditation and Compliance Division
Classification: Complex

https://prc.gov.ph/acd-resolutions-and-issuances

full_entry_text:
Application for Accreditation/Renewal of Accreditation as Continuing Professional Development (CPD) Provider
Refers to the process of accrediting entities who intend to offer CPD Programs

Office/Division: Central Office - Continuing Professional Development Division
Classification: Highly Technical
Type of Transaction: G2C (Government to Citizen)
Who may avail: Individual/Sole Proprietor, Firm/Partnership, Corporation, Cooperative, and Government Institutions/Agencies
Operating Hours: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Situational Requirements:
[A. LOCAL - New/Initial Application]
[Sub Situational Requirement/s]
[A.a. Individual / Sole Proprietor]
- A.a.1. Authenticated DTI Certificate of Registration
(1) Certified True Copy (Where to secure: Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) - -)
- A.a.2. Mayor's or Business Permit
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Local Government Unit (LGU) - -)
- A.a.3. Authenticated BIR Certificate of Registration and Tax Clearance
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) - -)
- A.a.4. Original Copy of NBI Clearance
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) - -)
- A.a.5. Valid Professional Identification Card (PIC) of the proprietor which shall be of the
same profession where application is intended to be submitted, along with his/her resume
that includes, among others, relevant educational background, current employment,
principal area of professional work, and number of years in the practice of the regulated
profession.
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Professional Regulation Commission and
Applicant - -)
- A.a.6. Profile which includes Mission, Vision, Core Values, and a list with details of
previous training programs and activities conducted, if any.
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- A.a.7. Instructional Design for at least three (3) programs
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Professional Regulation Commission and
Applicant - PRC Website for prescribed
template and accomplished by the Applicant)
- A.a.8. Affidavit of Undertaking
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Professional Regulation Commission and
Applicant - PRC Website for prescribed
template and accomplished by the Applicant)
[A.b. Firm / Partnership / Corporation/ Cooperative]
- A.b.1. Authenticated SEC or CDA Certificate of Registration and Articles of Incorporation or
Partnership and their respective By-laws.
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) or
Cooperative Development Authority (CDA) - -)
- A.b.2. Mayor's or Business Permit
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Local Government Unit - -)
- A.b.3. Authenticated BIR Certificate of Registration and Tax Clearance
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Bureau of Internal Revenue - -)
- A.b.4. List of officers with valid Professional Identification Card, if licensed professional
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant and Professional Regulation
Commission - -)
- A.b.5. Instructional Design for at least three (3) programs
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Professional Regulation Commission and
Applicant - PRC Website for prescribed
template and accomplished by the Applicant)
- A.b.6. Appointment paper from the managing partner authorizing the subject partner to
manage CPD programs; or Board Resolution/Secretary's Certificate of a Corporation
authorizing an officer, preferably a professional with valid Professional ID Card, to manage
CPD Programs, unless provided under existing guidelines of the concerned council that the
profession and license of the subject partner shall be of the same profession and license
where the application is intended to be submitted.
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- A.b.7. Affidavit of Undertaking
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Professional Regulation Commission and
Applicant - PRC Website for prescribed
template and accomplished by the Applicant)
[A.c. Government Institution/Agency]
- A.c.1. Copy of Charter or Republic Act establishing the agency
(1) Certified True Copy (Where to secure: Official Gazette, UP Law Center, or Congress -
-)
- A.c.2. Office Order or its equivalent from the head of Agency appointing its officer,
preferably a professional with valid Professional ID Card, to manage the CPD Programs,
unless provided under existing guidelines of the concerned council that the profession and
license of the officer, shall be of the same profession and license where the application is
intended to be submitted.
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- A.c.3. Instructional Design for at least three (3) programs
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Professional Regulation Commission and
Applicant - PRC Website for prescribed
template and accomplished by the Applicant)
[B. LOCAL - Renewal]
- B.1. Username and Password to access own CPDAS account
(Sample: - -) (Where to secure: Professional Regulation Commission -
cpdas.prc.gov.ph)
- B.2. Three-year Consolidated Report to include the following:
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
[Sub Requirement]
[B.2.A. List of CPD Programs and activities conducted for the last three (3) years]
[B.2.B. Audited Financial Report (For Private Entity)]
- B.3. Updated General Information Sheet for Corporation or Partnership or Cooperation
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) or
Cooperative Development Authority (CDA) - -)
- B.4. Amended Articles of Incorporation or Partnership or Cooperation and their respective
By-laws, if there are changes
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) or
Cooperative Development Authority (CDA) - -)
- B.5. Appointment paper from the managing partner authorizing the subject partner to
manage CPD programs; or Board Resolution/Secretary's Certificate of a Corporation
authorizing an officer to manage CPD programs; or Office Order or its equivalent from the
Head of the Government Agency appointing its officer to manage the CPD Programs, if there
are changes
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- B.6. Instructional Design for at least three (3) programs
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Professional Regulation Commission and
Applicant - PRC Website for prescribed
template and accomplished by the Applicant)
- B.7. Affidavit of Undertaking
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Professional Regulation Commission and
Applicant - PRC Website for prescribed
template and accomplished by the Applicant)
[C. FOREIGN - New/Initial Application]
- C.1. Proof of Registration of its creation in the Country/State of the applicant which must be
duly authenticated by the Philippine Embassy/Consulate in the said Country/State and
accompanied with English translation thereof/Apostille
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Issuing Country of Origin - -)
- C.2. Affidavit of Undertaking using the prescribed template, duly subscribed and sworn
before Philippine embassy/Consulate in the country/state of the applicant
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Professional Regulation Commission and
Embassy - PRC Website for prescribed
template and accomplished by the Applicant)
- C.3. Appointment paper of the representative from the Philippines duly authorized to
represent the foreign entity
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- C.4. Company Profile with Mission, Vision, Core Values, and if any, list and details of
previous training activities conducted
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- C.5. Instructional design for at least three (3) programs
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Professional Regulation Commission - PRC
Website for prescribed template and
accomplished by the Applicant)
[D. FOREIGN - Renewal]
- D.1. Username and Password to access own CPDAS account
(Sample: - -) (Where to secure: Professional Regulation Commission -
cpdas.prc.gov.ph)
- D.2. Updated General Information Sheet for Corporation and Partnership, or its equivalent.
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Issuing Country of Origin - -)
- D.3. dated General Information Sheet for Corporation and Partnership, or its equivalent.
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Issuing Country of Origin - -)
- D.4. Amended Articles of Incorporation or Partnership and their respective By-laws, if there
are changes
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Issuing Country of Origin - -)
- D.5. Appointment paper (or its equivalent) from the managing partner authorizing the subject
partner to manage the CPD programs, preferably a professional with valid Professional ID
Card to manage the CPD programs, unless provided under existing guidelines of the
concerned council that the profession and license of the subject partner shall be of the same
profession and license where the application is intended to be submitted; or Board
Resolution/Secretary's Certificate of a Corporation to represent the company and manage
the CPD Programs, if there are changes.
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- D.6. Appointment paper of the representative from the Philippines duly authorized to
represent the foreign entity
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- D.7. List of CPD Programs and activities for the last three (3) years
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- D.8. Instructional design for at least three (3) programs
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Professional Regulation Commission and
Applicant - PRC Website for prescribed
template and accomplished by the Applicant)
- D.9. Affidavit of Undertaking
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Professional Regulation Commission and
Applicant - PRC Website for prescribed
template and accomplished by the Applicant)

Refers to the process of accrediting specialty society/organization and other specialty categories providing structured training programs for professionals per professional qualification title and PQF Level.
Who may avail: Specialty society/organization/sub-specialty society, multidisciplinary specialty society/organization and other specialty categories providing structured training programs for professionals to become specialists or to have advanced/higher qualifications.
full_entry_text:
APPLICATION FOR ISSUANCE OF CERTIFICATE OF ACCREDITATION TO SPECIALTY SOCIETY/ORGANIZATION AND OTHER SPECIALTY CATEGORIES PROVIDING STRUCTURED TRAINING PROGRAMS FOR PROFESSIONALS PER PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATION TITLE AND PHILIPPINE QUALIFICATIONS FRAMEWORK (PQF) LEVEL
Refers to the process of accrediting specialty society/organization and other specialty categories providing structured training programs for professionals per professional qualification title and PQF Level.

Office/Division: Central Office - Qualification Recognition Division
Classification: Highly Technical
Type of Transaction: G2B (Government to Business), G2C (Government to Citizen)
Who may avail: Specialty society/organization/sub-specialty society, multidisciplinary specialty society/organization and other specialty categories providing structured training programs for professionals to become specialists or to have advanced/higher qualifications.
Operating Hours: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Situational Requirements:
[A. For New/Initial Application for Accreditation]
- A.1. Cover Document
(1) Original Copy And (1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Professional Regulation Commission - Career
Progression and Specialization Program -
Credit Accumulation and Transfer System
(CPSP-CATS))
  Note: Remarks:
PRC Website for prescribed template.
- A.2. Application form for accreditation
(1) Original Copy And (1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Professional Regulation Commission - Career
Progression and Specialization Program -
Credit Accumulation and Transfer System
(CPSP-CATS))
  Note: Remarks:
PRC Website for prescribed template and accomplished by the Applicant.
- A.3. Authenticated Copy of the Certificate of Registration from the Securities and Exchange
Commission (SEC)
(1) Certified True Copy And (1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) -
Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC))
- A.4. Authenticated Copy of the Articles of Incorporation and By-Laws
(1) Certified True Copy And (1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) -
Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC))
  Note: Remarks:
1. If the applicant is a specialty society/organization/sub-specialty society - One of its organizational purposes, as stated in its
Articles of Incorporation, is to maintain and enrich professional expertise in a particular field of professional practice through training
and assessment for updating and upgrading of competencies;
2. If the applicant is a multidisciplinary specialty society/organization - One of its organizational purposes, as stated in its Articles of
Incorporation, is to maintain and enrich professional expertise in a particular field of professional practice through training and
assessment for updating and upgrading of competencies
- A.5. Please submit photo copies of updated PRC Professional Identification Card (PIC) of
incorporators
(1) Photo Copy And (1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
All incorporators must belong to the same profession, if the applicant is a specialty society/organization/sub-specialty society; or All
incorporators must belong to the concerned profession, if the applicant is a multidisciplinary specialty society/organization.
- A.6. Authenticated Copy of the Certificate of Registration from the Bureau of Internal
Revenue (BIR)
(1) Certified True Copy And (1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) - Bureau of
Internal Revenue (BIR))
- A.7. Short brown envelope for the Certificate of Accreditation
(Sample: 1 piece) (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- A.9. USB Flash Drive
(Sample: 1 Piece) (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Please provide a USB Flash Drive containing the soft copies and/or scanned copies of all the documentary requirements herein. Please
submit the documents in hard and soft copies in an orderly manner based on the list indicated here.
[Sub Situational Requirement/s]
[A.a. DENTISTRY (Additional Requirements for New/Initial Application for Accreditation)]
- A.a.1. Letter to the Chairperson of the PRB of Dentistry
(1) Original Copy And (1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Indicating that the Dental Specialty Society or Sub-specialty Society applying to offer or provide structured training programs must:
1. Have a President who is a Certified Specialist (recognized specialist of the specialty society);
2. Be composed of members of the Accredited Integrated Professional Organization of dentists, dental hygienist and dental
technologists in the Philippines;
3. Be capable of strictly adhering to ALL the identified Professional Practice Outcomes in the Level Alignment Matrix of the issued PRB
of Dentistry Resolution;
4. Follow ALL the processes indicated in the issued PRB of Dentistry Resolution Guidelines on the Implementation of the CPSP of the
concerned Professional Qualification Title; and
5. Be recognized by a reputable international dental organization (with supporting document/s)
- A.a.2. For existing Dental Specialty Society or Sub-Specialty Society, certified list of
training institutions, if applicable, and training programs with assessment mechanisms
compliant and aligned with the issued PRB of Dentistry Resolutions on the Guidelines on
the Creation and Implementation of the Career Progression and Specialization Program of
the concerned Professional Qualification Title
(1) Original Copy And (1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
1. Please visit the PRC website (click the CPSP-CATS Tab) and check the PRB of Dentistry Resolution on the implementing guidelines
on the concerned CPSP and corresponding PQF Level for guidance of the applicant.
2. As to the training programs, please include the following information: Name/s of the facilitator/s and their qualifications, copies of
certificates for accredited training programs, duration of the training programs, venue where the training programs is undertaken, list
of the Professional Practice Outcomes (PPOs)/ Learning Outcomes (LOs) covered as aligned with the PRB of Dentistry Resolution on
the Implementation of the CPSP, date of offering, number of target participants.
- A.a.3. Certified list of the composition of the Specialty Executive Boards with their valid
PRC Professional Identification Cards (PICs) for local professionals
(1) Original Copy And (1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- A.a.4. Certified list of previously recognized specialists
(1) Original Copy And (1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- A.a.5. The credentials of at least nine (9) of either of its officers or members pertain to the
specialty training beyond undergraduate level
(1) Original Copy And (1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Which could be any of the following:
1. At least ten (10) years teaching experience in the specialty field with a minimum load of ten (10) hours a week AND must have a
local/international advanced education and training of the specialty field for at least one (1) year full-time;
2. An international advanced education and training of the specialty field for at least two (2) years full-time;
3. Previously issued Certificate of Recognition as Specialist by the Specialty Society

- B.a.1. Letter to the Chairperson of the PRB of Dentistry
(1) Original Copy And (1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)

technologists in the Philippines;

of Dentistry Resolution;
4. Follow ALL the processes indicated in the issued PRB of Dentistry Resolution Guidelines on the Implementation of the CPSP of the
concerned Professional Qualification Title; and
5. Be recognized by a reputable international dental organization (with supporting document/s
- B.a.2. Certified list of accredited training institutions and training programs conducted with
assessment mechanisms compliant and aligned with the issued PRB of Dentistry
Resolutions on the Guidelines on the Creation and Implementation of the Career
Progression and Specialization Program (CPSP) of the concerned Professional
Qualification Title
(1) Original Copy And (1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
1. Please visit the PRC website (click the CPSP-CATS Tab) and check the PRB of Dentistry Resolution on the implementing guidelines
on the concerned CPSP and corresponding PQF Level for guidance of the applicant.
2. As to the training programs, please include the following information: Name/s of the facilitator/s and their qualifications, copies of
certificates for accredited training programs, duration of the training programs, venue where the training programs is undertaken, list
of the Professional Practice Outcomes (PPOs)/ Learning Outcomes (LOs) covered as aligned with the PRB of Dentistry Resolution on
the Implementation of the CPSP, date of offering, number of target participants.
- B.a.3. Certified list of the composition of the Specialty Executive Board with their valid
Professional Identification Card for local professionals, if there are changes in the
composition
(1) Original Copy And (1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- B.a.4. Certified list of previously recognized specialists
(1) Original Copy And (1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
[C. Requirements for Representative for claiming the signed Certificate]
[C.1. Authorization Requirements
Any of the following:]
- C.1.A. If a representative is a PRC Registered professional – authorization letter and valid
PRC-issued Professional Identification Card (PIC)
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- C.1.B. If not PRC Registered professional - any valid government-issued Identification
Card and Notarized Special Power of Attorney (SPA)
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)

30. Client action: General Remarks
Section 2 of PRC Resolution No. 1591, s. 2022 (“Guidelines on the Accreditation of Specialty Society/Organization and Other Specialty
Categories Providing Structured Training Programs for Professionals”) states that each of the Professional Regulatory Boards (Board) shall
accredit specialty society/organization or other specialty categories per identified professional qualification title for their profession, whichever is
applicable. There shall only be one accredited specialty society/organization or other specialty categories per professional qualification title. xxx
In case there are two or more specialty societies/organizations or other specialty categories offering the same specialization in one profession,
the Board, through the Profession’s CPSP-CATS Committee, will facilitate a coalition of the said groups, as necessary.
In view of the foregoing, the processing period may vary in cases where two (2) or more specialty societies/organizations, or other specialty
categories, apply for accreditation under the same professional qualification title. | Agency action:  | Fee:  | Time:  | Responsible:

General Remarks
Section 2 of PRC Resolution No. 1591, s. 2022 (“Guidelines on the Accreditation of Specialty Society/Organization and Other Specialty
Categories Providing Structured Training Programs for Professionals”) states that each of the Professional Regulatory Boards (Board) shall
accredit specialty society/organization or other specialty categories per identified professional qualification title for their profession, whichever is
applicable. There shall only be one accredited specialty society/organization or other specialty categories per professional qualification title. xxx
In case there are two or more specialty societies/organizations or other specialty categories offering the same specialization in one profession,
the Board, through the Profession’s CPSP-CATS Committee, will facilitate a coalition of the said groups, as necessary.
In view of the foregoing, the processing period may vary in cases where two (2) or more specialty societies/organizations, or other specialty
categories, apply for accreditation under the same professional qualification title.

full_entry_text:
APPLICATION FOR QUALIFYING ASSESSMENT FOR FOREIGN MEDICAL PROFESSIONALS
This refers to the processing of applications of Foreign Medical Professionals (FMP) who intend to apply for the Qualifying Assessment for Foreign Medical Professionals (QA-FMP) to undergo residency or fellowship training in the Philippines.

Office/Division: Central Office - Qualification Recognition Division
Classification: Highly Technical
Type of Transaction: G2C (Government to Citizen)
Who may avail: Foreign Medical Professionals who are from non-ASEAN Member States
Operating Hours: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Standard Requirements:
- 1. Duly accomplished application form (IAO-QRD-33)
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Download from this link:
https://www.prc.gov.ph/residency-fellowship-training-forms
- 2. Letter of Intent to pursue medical residency or fellowship training in the Philippines
addressed to the Professional Regulatory Board of Medicine Chairperson detailing therein
his/her future professional plans, including place of practice after the completion of the training
program
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Note: Name of the Chairperson of the PRB of Medicine can be accessed in this link:
https://www.prc.gov.ph/professional-regulatory-boards
- 3. transcript of academic records, with official English translation, authenticated by the
Philippine Embassy/Consulate or with Apostille Certification
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Note: Legalization of document executed/issued abroad: Starting 14 May 2019, foreign documents from Apostille-contracting countries
(available at https://www.hcch.net/en/instruments/conventions/status-table/?cid=41) need not be authenticated abroad by Philippine
Embassies and Consulates General in order to be recognized and accepted in the Philippines. Apostille Certification or e-Apostille (electronic
copy) issued by the foreign competent authority responsible for the implementation of the Apostille Convention will be sufficient. While foreign
documents issued in non-member countries including Germany, shall have notarial (i.e., acknowledgement and jurat) with authentication from
the Philippine Embassies and Consulates. The document must be accompanied by an official English translation, if applicable.
- 4. Certification as a registered physician or its equivalent issued by the Ministry of
Health/Professional Regulatory Authority or such other appropriate regulatory body in the
foreign country/state, with official English translation, authenticated by the Philippine
Embassy/Consulate or with Apostille Certification

Embassies and Consulates General in order to be recognized and accepted in the Philippines. Apostille Certification or e-Apostille (electronic
copy) issued by the foreign competent authority responsible for the implementation of the Apostille Convention will be sufficient. While foreign
documents issued in non-member countries including Germany, shall have notarial (i.e., acknowledgement and jurat) with authentication from
the Philippine Embassies and Consulates. The document must be accompanied by an official English translation, if applicable.
- 5. letter of recommendation from the Dean of the College of Medicine from which he/she
graduated, with official English translation, authenticated by the Philippine Embassy/Consulate

full_entry_text:
APPLICATION FOR RECOGNITION OF PROFESSIONALS AS SPECIALISTS OR WITH ADVANCED OR HIGHER QUALIFICATIONS
Refers to the process of recognizing professionals as specialists or with advanced or higher qualifications.

Office/Division: Central Office - Qualification Recognition Division
Classification: Highly Technical
Type of Transaction: G2C (Government to Citizen)
Who may avail: Registered professionals with approved PRB Resolution recognizing the professionals as specialists or with advanced or higher qualifications.
Operating Hours: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Situational Requirements:
[A. DENTISTRY]
[Sub Situational Requirement/s]
[A.a. For New/Initial Application for Recognition of a Dental Specialist and Dental Sub-specialist]
- A.a.1. Checklist of Documentary Requirements/Cover Document
(1) Original Copy And (1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Please use the attached template - PRC Updated List of Requirements for Recognition
- A.a.2. Endorsement letter from the accredited dental specialty or sub-specialty society
addressed to the Chairperson of the PRB of Dentistry
(1) Original Copy And (1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
The name of the Chairperson of the PRB of Dentistry can be accessed on this link - PRB of Dentistry
- A.a.3. Certified list of qualified individuals with specialization (professional qualification title
recognized by the PRB and the PRC) and corresponding PQF Level they are applying for
(1) Original Copy And (1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Please use the attached template (Filename: List of Qualified Individuals-Matrix) PRC Template
- A.a.4. Application form (Application for recognition as a specialist or sub-specialist)
(1) Original Copy And (1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Please access this link for the application form: https://www.prc.gov.ph/recognition-professionals-advanced-or-higher-qualifications
- A.a.5. Personal Data Sheet
(1) Original Copy And (1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Plese refer to the PRC Website for the prescribed template to be accomplished by the applicant.
- A.a.6. Valid PRC’s Professional Identification Card of the qualified individual applicants
(1) Photo Copy And (1) Electronic Copy And (1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- A.a.7. Copy of a valid Certificate of Recognition from PRC as a specialist pursuant to PRB
of Dentistry Resolution No. 17 (s. 2008), if issued
(1) Original Copy And (1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- A.a.8. Originally signed Certificate of Non-Conviction by final judgment in administrative
offense where the penalty imposed is suspension or revocation of professional license and
criminal offense involving moral turpitude signed by the qualified individuals with
specialization
(1) Original Copy And (1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Please refer to the PRC Website for prescribed template to be accomplished by the Applicant.
- A.a.9. Proof that the qualified individual is an active member of the Accredited Integrated
Professional Organization (AIPO)
(1) Original Copy And (1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Please access this link for the AIPO in Dentistry: chrome-
extension://efaidnbmnnnibpcajpcglclefindmkaj/https://www.prc.gov.ph/sites/default/files/List%20of%20APOs_AIPOs%20as%20of%20March
%2011,%202026.pdf
- A.a.10. Evaluation Report signed by the respective Specialty/Sub-specialty Society and
Executive Board with a statement that the training programs conducted, and assessment
made, to the candidates are in accordance with the issued PRB of Dentistry Resolutions
(1) Original Copy And (1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- A.a.11. Short description of each nominee emphasizing the following information:
education, trainings and professional work experiences in the field of specialization
(1) Original Copy And (1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- A.a.12. Professional Portfolio prepared by the specialty society consisting of formal, non-
formal and informal learnings related to the specialty/ subspecialty field to include
professional work experience, awards and other related recognitions
(1) Original Copy And (1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Please use the attached template - Professional Portfolio
- A.a.13. Copy of a Certificate/s of formal education or training for at least one (1) year on
the particular field from a recognized Higher Education Institution locally or internationally
(1) Certified True Copy And (1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Please submit the documents in hard and soft/electronic copies in an orderly manner based on the above cited list of requirements.

chunk_title: APPLICATION FOR REGISTRATION WITH OR WITHOUT EXAMINATION BY A FOREIGNER
chunk_description: This refers to the processing of applications for registration without examination filed by foreign professionals who intend to permanently practice a regulated profession in the Philippines, if allowed by the professional regulatory law.
retrieval_text:
APPLICATION FOR REGISTRATION WITH OR WITHOUT EXAMINATION BY A FOREIGNER
This refers to the processing of applications for registration without examination filed by foreign professionals who intend to permanently practice a regulated profession in the Philippines, if allowed by the professional regulatory law.
Who may avail: Foreigners applying for registration: 1. with examination based on reciprocity; 2. with examination with pending application for naturalization as a Filipino citizen; 3. with examination who are DOJ-recognized refugees or stateless persons; and 4. without examination based on reciprocity.
full_entry_text:
APPLICATION FOR REGISTRATION WITH OR WITHOUT EXAMINATION BY A FOREIGNER
This refers to the processing of applications for registration without examination filed by foreign professionals who intend to permanently practice a regulated profession in the Philippines, if allowed by the professional regulatory law.

Office/Division: Central Office - Qualification Recognition Division
Classification: Highly Technical
Type of Transaction: G2C (Government to Citizen)
Who may avail: Foreigners applying for registration: 1. with examination based on reciprocity; 2. with examination with pending application for naturalization as a Filipino citizen; 3. with examination who are DOJ-recognized refugees or stateless persons; and 4. without examination based on reciprocity.
Operating Hours: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Standard Requirements:
- 1. Duly accomplished application form (IAO-QRD-54)
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Download from this link
https://www.prc.gov.ph/registration-or-without-exam-foreigner
- 2. valid passport as proof of citizenship
(1) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 3. passport size I.D. picture with complete name tag in white background
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 4. Official Receipt for the payment of non-refundable processing fee
(1) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)

Situational Requirements:
[A. Foreigners applying for registration with examination based on reciprocity]
- A.1. 1. A letter or any document signed by and under the official seal of the appropriate
official of the foreign state or country requesting the PRB Chairperson concerned to allow the
foreign applicant to take the licensure examination and that by express provision of the law
of the foreign state or country or international agreement to which the applicant’s state or
country is a signatory, the citizens of the Philippines are allowed to take the licensure
examination and to register as a professional in such foreign state or country.
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- A.2. An official copy of the foreign law or international agreement as proof of reciprocity for
the practice of profession, officially translated in the English Language, if applicable.
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Note: Registered Nutritionist Dieticians covered by the Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) between the Commission on Dietetic Registration
(CDR) and Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) do not need to submit the MOA as proof of reciprocity. Instead, a Verification
Statement from CDR confirming his/her qualifications and registration must be submitted.

full_entry_text:
CERTIFICATION OF QUALIFICATION OF FILIPINO MEDICAL TECHNOLOGISTS FOR HAWAII DOH
This refers to the processing of applications of Filipino Registered Medical Technologists who intend to apply as clinical laboratory personnel license in the State of Hawaii pursuant to the Memorandum of Understanding between PRC and the Hawaii Department of Health (HDOH).

Office/Division: Central Office - Qualification Recognition Division
Classification: Complex
Type of Transaction: G2C (Government to Citizen)
Who may avail: Filipino Medical Technologists who completed their Bachelor's Degree in A.Y. 2018.
Operating Hours: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Standard Requirements:
- 1. Duly accomplished Application form (IAO-QRD-47)
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Download the application form in this link:
https://www.prc.gov.ph/hawaii-department-health-hdoh
- 2. Duly accomplished HDOH’s Certification of Qualification
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Download from this link:
https://www.prc.gov.ph/hawaii-department-health-hdoh
- 3. transcript of records
(1) Certified True Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Certified true copy of the transcript of records shall be issued by the college/university where the HDOH applicant obtained the degree.
- 4. Certificate of Completion of Internship confirming that the applicant has completed the
internship training program from a laboratory in the Philippines which is accredited as a
training laboratory by the Philippine Government and affiliated with an academic institution
recognized and accepted by HDOH
(1) Certified True Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
The Certificate of Completion of Internship shall be issued by the training laboratory.
- 5. passport size picture with name tag
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 6. Valid PRC Professional Identification Card (PIC) or e-PIC
(1) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 7. PRC official receipt
(1) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Professional Regulation Commission -
Regional Office - Finance and Administrative
Division - Cash Section)

- A.b.2. authorization letter duly signed by the applicant
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)

EXEMPTION FROM TAKING QUALIFYING ASSESSMENT FOR FOREIGN MEDICAL PROFESSIONAL
This refers to the processing of applications from Foreign Medical Professionals (FMPs) who intend to apply for Exemption from taking the Qualifying Assessment for Foreign Medical Professionals (QA-FMP) to undergo medical residency or fellowship training program in the Philippines.

full_entry_text:
EXEMPTION FROM TAKING QUALIFYING ASSESSMENT FOR FOREIGN MEDICAL PROFESSIONAL
This refers to the processing of applications from Foreign Medical Professionals (FMPs) who intend to apply for Exemption from taking the Qualifying Assessment for Foreign Medical Professionals (QA-FMP) to undergo medical residency or fellowship training program in the Philippines.

Office/Division: Central Office - Qualification Recognition Division
Classification: Highly Technical
Type of Transaction: G2C (Government to Citizen)
Who may avail: Foreign Medical Professionals (FMP) from the ASEAN Member States who intend to undergo residency or fellowship training.
Operating Hours: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Standard Requirements:
- 1. Duly accomplished application form (IAO-QRD-33)
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Download the application form through this link:
https://www.prc.gov.ph/residency-fellowship-training-forms
- 2. Letter of Intent to pursue medical residency or fellowship training program in the Philippines
addressed to the Professional Regulatory Board of Medicine Chairperson detailing therein
his/her future professional plans, including place of practice after the completion of the training
program
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Note: Name of the Chairperson of the PRB of Medicine can be accessed in this link:
https://www.prc.gov.ph/professional-regulatory-boards
- 3. transcript of academic records, with official English translation, authenticated by the
Philippine Embassy/Consulate or with Apostille Certification
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
NOTE: Legalization of document executed/issued abroad: Starting 14 May 2019, foreign documents from Apostille-contracting countries
(available at https://www.hcch.net/en/instruments/conventions/status-table/?cid=41) need not be authenticated abroad by Philippine
Embassies and Consulates General in order to be recognized and accepted in the Philippines. Apostille Certification or e-Apostille (electronic
copy) issued by the foreign competent authority responsible for the implementation of the Apostille Convention will be sufficient. While foreign
documents issued in non-member countries including Germany, shall have notarial (i.e., acknowledgement and jurat) with authentication from
the Philippine Embassies and Consulates. The document must be accompanied by an official English translation, if applicable.
- 4. Certification as a registered physician or its equivalent issued by the Ministry of
Health/Professional Regulatory Authority or such other appropriate regulatory body in the
foreign country/state, with official English translation, authenticated by the Philippine
Embassy/Consulate or with Apostille Certification
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
NOTE: Legalization of document executed/issued abroad: Starting 14 May 2019, foreign documents from Apostille-contracting countries
(available at https://www.hcch.net/en/instruments/conventions/status-table/?cid=41) need not be authenticated abroad by Philippine
Embassies and Consulates General in order to be recognized and accepted in the Philippines. Apostille Certification or e-Apostille (electronic
copy) issued by the foreign competent authority responsible for the implementation of the Apostille Convention will be sufficient. While foreign
documents issued in non-member countries including Germany, shall have notarial (i.e., acknowledgement and jurat) with authentication from
the Philippine Embassies and Consulates. The document must be accompanied by an official English translation, if applicable.
- 5. letter of recommendation from the Dean of the College of Medicine from which he/she
graduated, with official English translation, authenticated by the Philippine Embassy/Consulate
or with Apostille Certification.
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 6. recent passport size picture with name tag
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 7. valid passport as proof of citizenship
(1) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 8. valid 9 (a) or Temporary Visitor’s Visa issued by the Bureau of Immigration
(1) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)

1. Duly accomplished application form (IAO-QRD-33)
(1) Original Copy

Remarks:
Download the application form through this link:
https://www.prc.gov.ph/residency-fellowship-training-forms

2. Letter of Intent to pursue medical residency or fellowship training program in the Philippines
addressed to the Professional Regulatory Board of Medicine Chairperson detailing therein
his/her future professional plans, including place of practice after the completion of the training
program
(1) Original Copy

Remarks:
Note: Name of the Chairperson of the PRB of Medicine can be accessed in this link:
https://www.prc.gov.ph/professional-regulatory-boards

3. transcript of academic records, with official English translation, authenticated by the
Philippine Embassy/Consulate or with Apostille Certification
(1) Original Copy

Remarks:
NOTE: Legalization of document executed/issued abroad: Starting 14 May 2019, foreign documents from Apostille-contracting countries
(available at https://www.hcch.net/en/instruments/conventions/status-table/?cid=41) need not be authenticated abroad by Philippine
Embassies and Consulates General in order to be recognized and accepted in the Philippines. Apostille Certification or e-Apostille (electronic
copy) issued by the foreign competent authority responsible for the implementation of the Apostille Convention will be sufficient. While foreign
documents issued in non-member countries including Germany, shall have notarial (i.e., acknowledgement and jurat) with authentication from
the Philippine Embassies and Consulates. The document must be accompanied by an official English translation, if applicable.

4. Certification as a registered physician or its equivalent issued by the Ministry of
Health/Professional Regulatory Authority or such other appropriate regulatory body in the
foreign country/state, with official English translation, authenticated by the Philippine
Embassy/Consulate or with Apostille Certification
(1) Original Copy

Remarks:
NOTE: Legalization of document executed/issued abroad: Starting 14 May 2019, foreign documents from Apostille-contracting countries
(available at https://www.hcch.net/en/instruments/conventions/status-table/?cid=41) need not be authenticated abroad by Philippine
Embassies and Consulates General in order to be recognized and accepted in the Philippines. Apostille Certification or e-Apostille (electronic
copy) issued by the foreign competent authority responsible for the implementation of the Apostille Convention will be sufficient. While foreign
documents issued in non-member countries including Germany, shall have notarial (i.e., acknowledgement and jurat) with authentication from
the Philippine Embassies and Consulates. The document must be accompanied by an official English translation, if applicable.

5. letter of recommendation from the Dean of the College of Medicine from which he/she
graduated, with official English translation, authenticated by the Philippine Embassy/Consulate
or with Apostille Certification.
(1) Original Copy

6. recent passport size picture with name tag
(1) Original Copy

7. valid passport as proof of citizenship
(1) Photo Copy

8. valid 9 (a) or Temporary Visitor’s Visa issued by the Bureau of Immigration
(1) Photo Copy

full_entry_text:
ISSUANCE OF SPECIAL PERMIT TO FORMER FILIPINO PROFESSIONALS
This refers to the processing of applications for the issuance of a Special Permit to Former Filipino Professionals.

Office/Division: Central Office - Qualification Recognition Division
Classification: Highly Technical
Type of Transaction: G2C (Government to Citizen)
Who may avail: Former Filipino Professionals who had been issued a Certification of Registration (COR) and a Professional Identification Card (PIC) before his/her naturalization as foreign citizens.
Operating Hours: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Standard Requirements:
- 1. duly accomplished application form (IAO-QRD-37)
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Download from this link: https://www.prc.gov.ph/former-filipino-professionals
- 2. Certificate of Employment (work must be related to applicant’s profession) or proof of
compliance with the Continuing Professional Development (CPD) requirement
(1) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 3. Certificate of with or with No Pending Administrative Case
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: PROFESSIONAL REGULATION
COMMISSION - Central Office-Hearing and
Investigation Division or Regional Office –
Legal Division/Section)

Situational Requirements:
[A. For permanent residents]
- A.1. Permanent resident card/visa
(1) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
[B. Requirements for Representative]
[Sub Situational Requirement/s]
[B.a. 2. Non-registered professional]
- B.a.1. any valid government-issued ID
(1) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- B.a.2. Special Power of Attorney (SPA) duly executed individually by the applicant
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
[B.b. 2. Registered professional]
- B.b.1. valid Professional Identification Card/e-PIC
(1) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- B.b.2. authorization letter duly signed by the applicant
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)

Who may avail: Foreign professionals who intend to practice a regulated profession in the Philippines under the following categories: Category 2 – Foreign professionals who are to be engaged as consultants in foreign-funded, joint venture, or foreign-assisted projects of the government Category 3 – Foreign professionals who are to be employed by local or foreign private firms or institutions Category 4 – Foreign professionals engaged in a humanitarian mission
full_entry_text:
ISSUANCE OF SPECIAL TEMPORARY PERMIT (STP) TO FOREIGN PROFESSIONALS (CATEGORIES 2, 3 AND 4)
This refers to the process of issuing Special Temporary Permits to foreign professionals who intend to practice a regulated profession in the Philippines for a limited period of time and for a specific purpose.

Office/Division: Central Office - Qualification Recognition Division
Classification: Highly Technical
Type of Transaction: G2C (Government to Citizen)
Who may avail: Foreign professionals who intend to practice a regulated profession in the Philippines under the following categories: Category 2 – Foreign professionals who are to be engaged as consultants in foreign-funded, joint venture, or foreign-assisted projects of the government Category 3 – Foreign professionals who are to be employed by local or foreign private firms or institutions Category 4 – Foreign professionals engaged in a humanitarian mission
Operating Hours: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Standard Requirements:
- 1. Duly accomplished application form (IAO-QRD-01)
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Download from this link
https://www.prc.gov.ph/special-temporary-permits
- 2. letter request to Professional Regulatory Board (PRB) Chairperson requesting for the
issuance of STP to the foreign professional indicating the date and venues of the undertaking
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Note: Names of PRBs can be accessed in this link:
https://www.prc.gov.ph/professional-regulatory-boards
- 3. valid passport as proof of citizenship
(1) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
The validity of the passport must be within the duration of the practice of the profession.
- 4. Authenticated or Apostilled Professional license issued by the competent regulatory
authority in his/her country with official English Translation thereof when necessary.
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Note:
For foreign Professionals, the applicant must submit an authenticated or apostilled Certificate of Specialization. The validity/expiration date
must be reflected on the professional license or certificate and it remains valid during the practice of profession in the Philippines. For
professional licenses/registration with lifetime validity, the applicant is required to submit an updated Certificate of Good Standing (COGS)
issued by the Professional Regulatory Authority (PRA) or in the absence of the PRA, COGS shall be issued by an Accredited Professional
Organization. In case of the latter, please inlcude an explanation and supporting documents, if any. The same must be
apostilled/authenticated.
- 5. updated Professional Identification Card of Filipino professional counterpart
(1) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 6. passport size I.D. picture in formal attire with complete name tag in white background
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 7. profession-specific documentary requirements
(1) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
For profession-specific documentary requirements, the same is available at:

full_entry_text:
ISSUANCE OF SPECIAL TEMPORARY PERMIT (STP) TO FOREIGN PROFESSIONALS BY VIRTUE OF RECIPROCITY OR INTERNATIONAL AGREEMENT (STP 1)
This refers to the process of issuing a Special Temporary Permit to foreign professionals who intend to practice a regulated profession in the Philippines for a limited period of time and for a specific venue, subject to reciprocity or international agreement on the practice of the profession between the Philippines and the foreigner’s country.

Office/Division: Central Office - Qualification Recognition Division
Classification: Highly Technical
Type of Transaction: G2C (Government to Citizen)
Who may avail: Foreign professionals who intend to practice a regulated profession in the Philippines, particularly for the following professions: Architecture, Agricultural and Biosystems Engineering, Environmental Planning, Geodetic Engineering, Landscape Architecture, Radiologic Technology, and Real Estate Service.
Operating Hours: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Standard Requirements:
- 1. Duly accomplished application form (IAO-QRD-01)
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Download from this link
https://www.prc.gov.ph/special-temporary-permits
- 2. valid passport as proof of citizenship
(1) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
The validity of the passport must be within the duration of the practice of the profession.
- 3. Authenticated or Apostilled Copy of a Professional license issued by the competent
regulatory authority in his/her country with official English Translation thereof when necessary.
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Note: For foreign Professionals, the applicant must submit an authenticated or apostilled Certificate of Specialization. The validity/expiration
date must be reflected on the professional license or certificate, and it remains valid during the practice of the profession in the Philippines. For
professional licenses/registration with lifetime validity, the applicant is required to submit an updated Certificate of Good Standing (COGS)
issued by the Professional Regulatory Authority (PRA). The same must be apostilled/authenticated.
- 4. updated Professional Identification Card of Filipino professional counterpart
(1) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Note: The Filipino professional counterpart for the following professions:
Accountancy: If the foreign national is an ASEAN CPA, the counterpart should be a Filipino ASEAN CPA.
Electronics Engineering: There must be at least two (2) Filipino electronics engineer counterparts for every foreign professional.
Geodetic Engineering: The Filipino counterpart must be a member in good standing with the A.P.O.
Interior Design: The Filipino counterpart must be in continuous practice of interior design for at least ten (10) years).
- 5. passport size I.D. picture in formal attire with complete name tag in white background
(1) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 6. Letter request to the PRB Chairperson requesting for the issuance of STP to the foreign
professional indicating the following in bullet points the date and venue of the undertaking and
name of Filipino Professional counterpart with current roles and responsibilities in the
company to qualify as counterpart and provide with narratives of the detailed expertise, skills
and competencies of foreign applicant that will be transferred to the counterpart for the
duration of the undertaking of foreign applicant
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 7. Authenticated/apostilled official copy of the foreign law or international agreement as proof
of reciprocity for the practice of profession, officially translated in the English Language, if
applicable.
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 8. Contract of Employment or Services, or Memorandum of Agreement between the employer
and the foreign professional indicating the terms of reference, nature of engagement, scope,
duration and other project or contract details
(1) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)

Situational Requirements:
[A. Requirements for Representative]
[Sub Situational Requirement/s]
[A.a. Non-registered professional]
- A.a.1. valid government-issued ID
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- A.a.2. Special Power of Attorney (SPA) duly executed individually by the applicant
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
[A.b. Registered professional]
- A.b.1. valid Professional Identification Card/e-PIC
(1) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- A.b.2. authorization letter duly signed by the applicant
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
[B. REQUEST FOR EXEMPTION OR EXCLUSION FROM THE REQUIREMENTS OF SPECIAL TEMPORARY PERMIT]
- B.1. Letter request addressed to the Professional Regulatory Board (PRB) requesting for an
exemption or exclusion from the STP requirements by citing clear factual and/or legal basis
for an exemption or exclusion.
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Note: Names of PRBs can be accessed in this link: https://www.prc.gov.ph/professional- regulatory-boards
- B.2. valid passport as proof of citizenship
(1) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- B.3. Contract of Employment or Services, or Memorandum of Agreement between the
employer and the foreign professional, indicating the terms of reference, nature of
engagement, scope, duration and other project or contract details
(1) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)

retrieval_text:

full_entry_text:
ISSUANCE OF TEMPORARY TRAINING PERMIT TO FOREIGN MEDICAL PROFESSIONAL
This refers to the processing of applications of Foreign Medical Professionals (FMPs) who intend to apply for a Temporary Training Permit (TTP) to undergo medical residency or fellowship training program in the Philippines.

Office/Division: Central Office - Qualification Recognition Division
Classification: Highly Technical
Type of Transaction: G2C (Government to Citizen)
Who may avail: Foreign Medical Professionals who passed the Qualifying Assessment for Foreign Medical Professionals (QA-FMP) or have a Certificate of Exemption from Taking QA-FMP
Operating Hours: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Standard Requirements:
- 1. Duly accomplished application form (IAO-QRD-32)
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Download the application form through this link:
https://www.prc.gov.ph/residency-fellowship-training-forms
- 2. Training Contract signed by the Medical Director or Head of the training institution/hospital
(1) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
The training contract shall stipulate the duration, terms and conditions of the training, including payment of the prescribed training fees and
insurance fees (e.g. medical malpractice insurance), as may be required by the institution/hospital. The contract shall also indicate that the
foreign medical professional shall not receive from the training hospital/institution any monetary compensation for the duration of his/her
medical residency/fellowship training therein.
- 3. letter of appointment signed by the Medical Director or Head of the training
institution/hospital indicating that the foreign medical professional has been accepted in the
medical residency or fellowship training program
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 4. valid passport as proof of citizenship
(1) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 5. Certificate of Passing / Certificate of Exemption from the taking the QA-FMP
(1) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Professional Regulation Commission -
Regional Office - Regulation Division)
- 6. recent passport size picture with name tag
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)

full_entry_text:
REGISTRATION AS ASEAN ARCHITECTS (AA)
This refers to the processing of applications of Filipino registered Architects who intend to register as ASEAN Architects pursuant to the ASEAN Mutual Recognition Arrangement on Architectural Services.

Office/Division: Central Office - Qualification Recognition Division
Classification: Highly Technical
Type of Transaction: G2C (Government to Citizen)
Who may avail: All PRC-registered Filipino Architects
Operating Hours: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Standard Requirements:
- 1. Letter of intent
(3) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
NOTE:
1) Three (3) sets of the accomplished application forms, including copies of all supporting documents must be submitted; A4 size (8.27" x
11.69") of paper shall be used throughout; Colored print for the original copies, black print may be used for other copies. Photocopies of large
documents shall be reduced accordingly. Each set shall be submitted in 1 1⁄2”, 3 – Ring Presentation Binder, (White for ORIGINAL, Black for
the 2 copies), Documents shall be in a clear sheet insert, complete with table of contents/tabs.
2) All applications must be originally-signed by the applicant and shall be delivered to nearest PRC Regional Office.
3) EMAILED APPLICATIONS OR COMPUTER-GENERATED SIGNATURES ON THE APPLICATION FORMS WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED.
- 2. Duly accomplished application form (IAO- QRD-15)
(3) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Download from this link
https://www.prc.gov.ph/asean-mra
- 3. transcript of records
(1) Original Copy Or (1) Certified True Copy And (2) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 4. valid PRC Professional Identification Card (PIC)/ e-PIC
(3) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 5. Certificate of Good Standing (COGS)
(1) Original Copy And (2) Photo Copy (Where to secure: United Architects of the Philippines - United
Architects of the Philippines)
- 6. valid NBI Clearance
(1) Original Copy And (2) Photo Copy (Where to secure: National Bureau of Investigation - National
Bureau of Investigation)
- 7. signed and notarized Statement of Compliance with the code of ethics
(1) Original Copy And (2) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 8. Certificates of Specialized Training relevant to the field of specialization (Annex 1)
(3) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 9. certificates of employment or any documents establishing acquired practical and diversified
architectural experience of not less than seven (7) years of continuous architectural practice
after graduation, of which at least two (2) years of post-graduate architectural experiences,
and five (5) years post-licensure architectural practice; Spent at least two (2) years in
responsible charge of significant architectural works within the five (5) years of professional
architectural practice (Annex 2)
(3) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Annex 2A- Description of the Project
Annex 2B- Project Images
- 10. Certificate of Continuing Professional Development (CPD) Compliance (Annex 3)
(1) Original Copy And (2) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Professional Regulation Commission-Regional
Office - Regulation Division)
- 11. published research papers, if available (Annex 4)
(3) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 12. proof of authorship, if available (Annex 5)
(3) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 13. recent passport size pictures
(4) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
white background with name tag (coat and tie for men; blazer for women)
- 14. PRC official receipt
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Professional Regulation Commission- Regional
Office - Finance and Administrative Division-
Cash Section)
- 15. flash drive containing soft copies of the AA application documents
(Sample: 1 piece at least 1GB as long as it can contain the complete application documents ) (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Note: The documentary requirements must be scanned in an orderly manner based on the list above, saved as a single file.

(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)

31. Client action: General Remarks
For step 1.7: Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) between and among PRC, CHED, UAP, Assessment Statement and Implementing Rules and
Regulations (IRR)
For step 1.14: The ASEAN Architect Council (AAC) is composed of Professional Regulatory Authorities from the ASEAN Member States; For
step 4.15: AAC meetings convene thrice a year based on ASEAN schedule (e.g. February/ June/ October)
NOTE: The whole process is governed by the ASEAN Trade-in Services Agreement (ATISA), pertaining to Article 17 on Recognition: To recognize
the education or experience obtained, requirements met, or licenses or certifications granted in another Member State, for the purpose of
licensing or certification of service suppliers. This gives basis for the ASEAN Mutual Recognition Arrangement on Architectural Services which
aims to: (a) strengthen economic linkages and provide greater opportunities for economic development; (b) increase trade and investment in the
area of services and create larger markets and greater economies of scale; (c) reduce barriers to trade and investment in services and create a
predictable business environment; (d) strengthen economic relations between Member States through: inter alia promoting and facilitating
utilization of the greater opportunities provided by the Agreement; promoting regulatory cooperation; developing co-operation in the field of
human resource development; and increasing the participation of small and medium enterprises in trade and investment activities; and (e) narrow
development gaps between Member States to achieve a more equitable, balanced and sustainable socio-economic development. | Agency action:  | Fee:  | Time:  | Responsible:

General Remarks
For step 1.7: Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) between and among PRC, CHED, UAP, Assessment Statement and Implementing Rules and
Regulations (IRR)
For step 1.14: The ASEAN Architect Council (AAC) is composed of Professional Regulatory Authorities from the ASEAN Member States; For
step 4.15: AAC meetings convene thrice a year based on ASEAN schedule (e.g. February/ June/ October)
NOTE: The whole process is governed by the ASEAN Trade-in Services Agreement (ATISA), pertaining to Article 17 on Recognition: To recognize
the education or experience obtained, requirements met, or licenses or certifications granted in another Member State, for the purpose of
licensing or certification of service suppliers. This gives basis for the ASEAN Mutual Recognition Arrangement on Architectural Services which
aims to: (a) strengthen economic linkages and provide greater opportunities for economic development; (b) increase trade and investment in the
area of services and create larger markets and greater economies of scale; (c) reduce barriers to trade and investment in services and create a
predictable business environment; (d) strengthen economic relations between Member States through: inter alia promoting and facilitating
utilization of the greater opportunities provided by the Agreement; promoting regulatory cooperation; developing co-operation in the field of
human resource development; and increasing the participation of small and medium enterprises in trade and investment activities; and (e) narrow
development gaps between Member States to achieve a more equitable, balanced and sustainable socio-economic development.

full_entry_text:
REGISTRATION AS ASEAN CHARTERED PROFESSIONAL ACCOUNTANTS (ASEAN CPA)
This refers to the processing of applications for registration as ASEAN Chartered Professional Accountants (ASEAN CPA).

Office/Division: Central Office - Qualification Recognition Division
Classification: Highly Technical
Type of Transaction: G2C (Government to Citizen)
Who may avail: All PRC Registered Filipino Certified Public Accountants
Operating Hours: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Standard Requirements:
- 1. Letter of intent
(2) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Note:
Two (2) sets of the accomplished application form, including copies of all supporting documents, must be submitted; Legal-sized (8 1⁄2” x 13”)
paper shall be used throughout; Photocopies of large documents shall be reduced accordingly. Each set shall be submitted in a ring binder
with a table of contents, tabs, and paged accordingly. The Application Form must be originally signed by the applicant.
- 2. Duly accomplished application form (IAO-QRD-38)
(2) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Download from this link: https://www.prc.gov.ph/asean-mra
- 3. Certificate of CPD Compliance
(2) Original Copy (Where to secure: Professional Regulation Commission -Regional
Office - Regulation Division)
- 4. valid PRC Professional Identification Card (PIC)
(2) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 5. certificate of no pending administrative case issued by Regional Office – Legal
Division/Section
(1) Original Copy And (1) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Professional Regulation Commission- Regional
Office - Legal Division/ Legal Section)
- 6. Certificate of Good Standing (COGS) for ASEAN CPA Registration
(1) Original Copy And (1) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Philippine Institute of Certified Public
Accountants (PICPA) - Philippine Institute of
Certified Public Accountants (PICPA))
- 7. certificates of employment or any documents establishing a proof of professional practice of
not less than three (3) years
(2) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 8. passport size pictures with name tag
(2) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
photos must be in white background;
coat and tie for men;
blazer for women
