full_entry_text:
REGISTRATION AS ASEAN CHARTERED PROFESSIONAL ENGINEERS (ACPE)
This refers to the processing of applications for Filipino registered and licensed Engineers who intend to register as ACPE pursuant to the ASEAN Mutual Recognition Arrangement on Engineering Services.

Office/Division: Central Office - Qualification Recognition Division
Classification: Highly Technical
Type of Transaction: G2C (Government to Citizen)
Who may avail: All PRC-registered Filipino Engineers
Operating Hours: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Standard Requirements:
- 1. Letter of intent
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 2. Duly accomplished application form (IAO-QRD-08)
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Download from this link
https://www.prc.gov.ph/asean-mra
- 3. Certificate of CPD Compliance
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Professional Regulation Commission -
Regional Office - Regulation Division)
- 4. valid PRC Professional Identification Card (PIC)/e-PIC
(1) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 5. Certificate Good Standing
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Accredited Professional Organization/
Integrated Accredited Professional
Organization - Accredited Professional
Organization/ Integrated Accredited
Professional Organization)
- 6. signed and notarized Statement of Compliance with the code of ethics
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 7. Certificates of employment and/or Certification of Project completion, or any documents
establishing a practical and diversified experience of not less than 7 years, at least 2 years of
which shall be in responsible charge of significant engineering works
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)

- A.b.2. authorization letter duly signed by the applicant
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)

For step 1.13: ACPECC (ASEAN Chartered Professional Engineer Coordinating Committee): composed of Professional Regulatory Authorities
from ASEAN Member States
For step 1.13: ACPECC meetings convene thrice a year based on ASEAN schedule (e.g. February/ June/ October)
NOTE: The whole process is governed by the ASEAN Trade-in Services Agreement (ATISA), pertaining to Article 17 on Recognition: To recognize
the education or experience obtained, requirements met, or licenses or certifications granted in another Member State, for the purpose of
licensing or certification of service suppliers. This gives basis for the ASEAN Mutual Recognition Arrangement on Engineering Services which
aims to: (a) strengthen economic linkages and provide greater opportunities for economic development; (b) increase trade and investment in the
area of services and create larger markets and greater economies of scale; (c) reduce barriers to trade and investment in services and create a
predictable business environment; (d) strengthen economic relations between Member States through: inter alia promoting and facilitating
utilization of the greater opportunities provided by the Agreement; promoting regulatory cooperation; developing co-operation in the field of
human resource development; and increasing the participation of small and medium enterprises in trade and investment activities; and (e) narrow

General Remarks
For step 1.6: Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) between and among PRC, CHED and PTC, Assessment Statement and Implementing Rules
and Regulations (IRR)
For step 1.13: ACPECC (ASEAN Chartered Professional Engineer Coordinating Committee): composed of Professional Regulatory Authorities
from ASEAN Member States
For step 1.13: ACPECC meetings convene thrice a year based on ASEAN schedule (e.g. February/ June/ October)
NOTE: The whole process is governed by the ASEAN Trade-in Services Agreement (ATISA), pertaining to Article 17 on Recognition: To recognize
the education or experience obtained, requirements met, or licenses or certifications granted in another Member State, for the purpose of
licensing or certification of service suppliers. This gives basis for the ASEAN Mutual Recognition Arrangement on Engineering Services which
aims to: (a) strengthen economic linkages and provide greater opportunities for economic development; (b) increase trade and investment in the
area of services and create larger markets and greater economies of scale; (c) reduce barriers to trade and investment in services and create a
predictable business environment; (d) strengthen economic relations between Member States through: inter alia promoting and facilitating
utilization of the greater opportunities provided by the Agreement; promoting regulatory cooperation; developing co-operation in the field of
human resource development; and increasing the participation of small and medium enterprises in trade and investment activities; and (e) narrow
development gaps between Member States to achieve a more equitable, balanced and sustainable socio-economic development.

full_entry_text:
Registration of APEC Architect
This refers to the application of qualified Filipino Architects for registration as APEC Architects in the Book of Registry in accordance with the Memorandum of Agreement among Professional Regulation Commission (PRC), United Architects of the Philippines (UAP) and the Commission on Higher Education (CHED) entered on 28 January 2004.

Office/Division: Central Office - Qualification Recognition Division
Classification: Highly Technical
Type of Transaction: G2C (Government to Citizen)
Who may avail: All Filipino PRC-Registered Architects
Operating Hours: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Standard Requirements:
- 1. Cover Letter
(1) Original Copy And (2) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Sample cover letter and other requirements can be accessed here:

STRATION%20AS%20AN%20APEC%20ARCHITECT%20WITH%20FORMS.2025.updated.pdf
- 2. Detailed Curriculum Vitae
(1) Original Copy And (2) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 3. Certificate of Good Standing
(1) Certified True Copy And (2) Photo Copy (Where to secure: United Architects of the Philippines (UAP) -
United Architects of the Philippines (UAP))
- 4. Notarized Certification of Authenticity of Information and Document
(1) Original Copy And (2) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Template can be accessed here:
chrome-
extension://efaidnbmnnnibpcajpcglclefindmkaj/https://www.prc.gov.ph/sites/default/files/STEPS%20FOR%20APPLICATION%20FOR%20REGI
STRATION%20AS%20AN%20APEC%20ARCHITECT%20WITH%20FORMS.2025.updated.pdf
- 5. NBI Clearance
(1) Original Copy And (2) Photo Copy (Where to secure: National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) -
National Bureau of Investigation (NBI))
- 6. Official Receipt
(1) Original Copy And (2) Photo Copy (Where to secure: United Architects of the Philippines (UAP) -
United Architects of the Philippines (UAP))
- 7. Flash Drive
(Sample: 1 piece 1GB or higher as long as it can secure complete application documents) (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 8. Application form and its attachments
(1) Original Copy And (2) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
The application form shall be secured from the United Architects of the Philippines (UAP).
Further information and guidelines on the application documents can be accessed here:
chrome-
extension://efaidnbmnnnibpcajpcglclefindmkaj/https://www.prc.gov.ph/sites/default/files/STEPS%20FOR%20APPLICATION%20FOR%20REGI
STRATION%20AS%20AN%20APEC%20ARCHITECT%20WITH%20FORMS.2025.updated.pdf
- 9. Valid PRC Professional Identification Card / e-PIC
(3) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 10. PRC Certificate of Registration (COR)
(3) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 11. Diploma certificates for the degrees obtained (Baccalaureate and Post-Baccalaureate, if
applicable)
(3) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 12. short statement of your post-baccalaureate diversified training as required before
Licensure Examination
(1) Original Copy And (2) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Mention the names of firms in which training was undertaken, and the assignments given as a trainee. (Optional requirement: Nominee may
reinforce the hereunder statements with signature of Mentor or Principal of the architectural office or firm.)
The template is attached in the application form from UAP.
- 13. Record of relevant professional practice and experience
(1) Original Copy And (2) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Applicants for APEC Architect registration shall complete the following record of relevant experiences in the Tables attached. The definition of
some terms that will help the applicant sort out and organize his experiences are included below.
TABLE 1: PRACTICE DURING THE IMMEDIATE PAST THREE (3) YEARS FROM DATE OF APPLICATION, AS AN ARCHITECT WITH
SOLE RESPONSIBILITY FOR BUILDINGS OF MODERATE COMPLEXITY.
TABLE 2: PRACTICE DURING THE IMMEDIATE PAST THREE (3) YEARS FROM THE DATE OF APPLICATION, AS AN ARCHITECT
WORKING IN COLLABORATION WITH OTHER ARCHITECTS, IN CHARGE OF AND PROFESSIONALLY RESPONSIBLE FOR A
SIGNIFICANT ASPECT, BE IT DESIGN, DOCUMENTATION AND/OR CONTRACT ADMINISTRATION, OF COMPLEX
BUILDINGS.
TABLE 3: PRACTICE DURING THE IMMEDIATE PAST THREE (3) YEARS FROM DATE OF APPLICATION AS AN ARCHITECT WITH SOLE
RESPONSIBILITY FOR COMPLEX BUILDINGS.
TABLE 4: GENERAL EXPERIENCE GAINED IN PROFESSIONAL PRACTICE AS AN ARCHITECT (A minimum additional four (4)-year
experience is required. However, applicant may include experience beyond these four (4) years.)
- 14. Record of Continuing Professional Development
(1) Original Copy And (2) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Applicants for APEC Architect registration shall complete the following groups of record of Continuing Professional Development, as
applicable:
TABLE 5A: RECORD OF CONTINUING PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: SEMINARS AND CONVENTIONS AS PARTICIPANT
TABLE 5B: RECORD OF CONTINUING PROFESSONAL DEVELOPMENT: SEMINARS AND CONVENTIONS AS RESOURCE SPEAKER /
PAPER PRESENTER
TABLE 5C: RECORD OF CONTINUING PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: SEMINARS AND CONVENTIONS AS PANELIST / REACTOR
TABLE 5D: RECORD OF CONTINUING PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: SEMINARS AND CONVENTIONS AS FACILITATOR /
MODERATOR
TABLE 6: RECORD OF CONTINUING PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: ACADEMIC PREPARATION
TABLE 7A: RECORD OF CONTINUING PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: SELF-DIRECTED LEARNING PACKAGE USING MODULES
TABLE 7B: RECORD OF CONTINUING PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: SELF-DIRECTED LEARNING PACKAGE USING TECHNICAL
PAPERS/PROFESSIONAL JOURNAL ARTICLES
TABLE 8A: RECORD OF CONTINUING PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: AUTHORSHIP THRU RESEARCH WORKS
TABLE 8B: RECORD OF CONTINUING PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: AUTHORSHIP THRU A BOOK / MONOGRAM
TABLE 8C: RECORD OF CONTINUING PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: AUTHORSHIP AS EDITOR OF A BOOK
TABLE 8D: RECORD OF CONTINUING PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: AUTHORSHIP AS EDITOR OF A PROFESSIONAL JOURNAL
TABLE 8E: RECORD OF CONTINUING PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: AUTHORSHIP THRU PEER REVIEW
TABLE 9: RECORD OF CONTINUING PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: STUDY / OBSERVATION
- 15. Record of Research and Development
(1) Original Copy And (2) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 16. Record of Service to the Profession
(1) Original Copy And (2) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Applicants for APEC Architect registration shall complete the following tables to document their service to such institutions/organizations as the
Board of Architecture, the Integrated and Accredited Professional Organization of Architects, and other professional organizations of
architects.) Please list positions held per term of office. TABLE 12A: SERVICE TO THE PROFESSION: As member of the Board of
Architecture, Professional Regulation Commission
TABLE 12B: SERVICE TO THE PROFESSION: As National Executive Officer of UAP-IAPOA and/or equivalent positions in other architectural
professional organizations
TABLE 12C: SERVICE TO THE PROFESSION: As District Director/Executive Director of UAP-IAPOA and/or equivalent positions in other
architectural professional organizations
TABLE 12D: SERVICE TO THE PROFESSION: As National Standing Committee Chair of the UAP-IAPOA And/or equivalent positions in other
architectural professional organizations
TABLE 12E: SERVICE TO THE PROFESSION: As Chapter President of the UAP-IAPOA and/or equivalent Positions in other architectural
professional organizations
TABLE 12F: SERVICE TO THE PROFESSION: As Office Bearer of international organizations of architects (UIA, ARCASIA, APEC
ARCHITECT COUNCIL)
TABLE 12G: SERVICE TO THE PROFESSION: As Member of international organizations of architects (UIA, ARCASIA, APEC ARCHITECT
COUNCIL)

13. Record of relevant professional practice and experience
(1) Original Copy And (2) Photo Copy

Remarks:
Applicants for APEC Architect registration shall complete the following record of relevant experiences in the Tables attached. The definition of
some terms that will help the applicant sort out and organize his experiences are included below.
TABLE 1: PRACTICE DURING THE IMMEDIATE PAST THREE (3) YEARS FROM DATE OF APPLICATION, AS AN ARCHITECT WITH
SOLE RESPONSIBILITY FOR BUILDINGS OF MODERATE COMPLEXITY.
TABLE 2: PRACTICE DURING THE IMMEDIATE PAST THREE (3) YEARS FROM THE DATE OF APPLICATION, AS AN ARCHITECT
WORKING IN COLLABORATION WITH OTHER ARCHITECTS, IN CHARGE OF AND PROFESSIONALLY RESPONSIBLE FOR A
SIGNIFICANT ASPECT, BE IT DESIGN, DOCUMENTATION AND/OR CONTRACT ADMINISTRATION, OF COMPLEX
BUILDINGS.
TABLE 3: PRACTICE DURING THE IMMEDIATE PAST THREE (3) YEARS FROM DATE OF APPLICATION AS AN ARCHITECT WITH SOLE
RESPONSIBILITY FOR COMPLEX BUILDINGS.
TABLE 4: GENERAL EXPERIENCE GAINED IN PROFESSIONAL PRACTICE AS AN ARCHITECT (A minimum additional four (4)-year
experience is required. However, applicant may include experience beyond these four (4) years.)

14. Record of Continuing Professional Development
(1) Original Copy And (2) Photo Copy

Remarks:
Applicants for APEC Architect registration shall complete the following groups of record of Continuing Professional Development, as
applicable:
TABLE 5A: RECORD OF CONTINUING PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: SEMINARS AND CONVENTIONS AS PARTICIPANT
TABLE 5B: RECORD OF CONTINUING PROFESSONAL DEVELOPMENT: SEMINARS AND CONVENTIONS AS RESOURCE SPEAKER /
PAPER PRESENTER
TABLE 5C: RECORD OF CONTINUING PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: SEMINARS AND CONVENTIONS AS PANELIST / REACTOR
TABLE 5D: RECORD OF CONTINUING PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: SEMINARS AND CONVENTIONS AS FACILITATOR /
MODERATOR
TABLE 6: RECORD OF CONTINUING PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: ACADEMIC PREPARATION
TABLE 7A: RECORD OF CONTINUING PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: SELF-DIRECTED LEARNING PACKAGE USING MODULES
TABLE 7B: RECORD OF CONTINUING PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: SELF-DIRECTED LEARNING PACKAGE USING TECHNICAL
PAPERS/PROFESSIONAL JOURNAL ARTICLES
TABLE 8A: RECORD OF CONTINUING PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: AUTHORSHIP THRU RESEARCH WORKS
TABLE 8B: RECORD OF CONTINUING PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: AUTHORSHIP THRU A BOOK / MONOGRAM
TABLE 8C: RECORD OF CONTINUING PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: AUTHORSHIP AS EDITOR OF A BOOK
TABLE 8D: RECORD OF CONTINUING PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: AUTHORSHIP AS EDITOR OF A PROFESSIONAL JOURNAL
TABLE 8E: RECORD OF CONTINUING PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: AUTHORSHIP THRU PEER REVIEW
TABLE 9: RECORD OF CONTINUING PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT: STUDY / OBSERVATION

15. Record of Research and Development
(1) Original Copy And (2) Photo Copy

16. Record of Service to the Profession
(1) Original Copy And (2) Photo Copy

Remarks:
Applicants for APEC Architect registration shall complete the following tables to document their service to such institutions/organizations as the
Board of Architecture, the Integrated and Accredited Professional Organization of Architects, and other professional organizations of
architects.) Please list positions held per term of office. TABLE 12A: SERVICE TO THE PROFESSION: As member of the Board of
Architecture, Professional Regulation Commission
TABLE 12B: SERVICE TO THE PROFESSION: As National Executive Officer of UAP-IAPOA and/or equivalent positions in other architectural
professional organizations
TABLE 12C: SERVICE TO THE PROFESSION: As District Director/Executive Director of UAP-IAPOA and/or equivalent positions in other
architectural professional organizations
TABLE 12D: SERVICE TO THE PROFESSION: As National Standing Committee Chair of the UAP-IAPOA And/or equivalent positions in other
architectural professional organizations
TABLE 12E: SERVICE TO THE PROFESSION: As Chapter President of the UAP-IAPOA and/or equivalent Positions in other architectural
professional organizations
TABLE 12F: SERVICE TO THE PROFESSION: As Office Bearer of international organizations of architects (UIA, ARCASIA, APEC
ARCHITECT COUNCIL)
TABLE 12G: SERVICE TO THE PROFESSION: As Member of international organizations of architects (UIA, ARCASIA, APEC ARCHITECT
COUNCIL)

full_entry_text:
Registration of APEC Engineer
This refers to the application of qualified Filipino Engineers for registration as APEC Engineer in the Book of Registry in accordance with the Memorandum of Agreement among PRC, Philippine Technological Council (PTC) and CHED entered on May 22, 2000.

Office/Division: Central Office - Qualification Recognition Division
Classification: Highly Technical
Type of Transaction: G2C (Government to Citizen)
Who may avail: All Filipino PRC-Registered Engineers
Operating Hours: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Standard Requirements:
- 1. Application form and its attachments
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
The application form shall be secured from the Philippine Technological Council (PTC).
Submit 3 sets of hard copies of all the completed application documents using A4 size white bond paper of not less than 80gsm
substance thickness.
Submit a soft copy of all the completed application documents.
- 2. Valid PRC Professional Identification Card/ e-PIC
(1) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 3. PRC Certificate of Registration
(1) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 4. Record of CPD Compliance (Form 6)
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Using the Guidelines established by the Philippine Technological Council (PTC), applicant for APEC Engineer are required to undertake at
least 150 weighted hours of CPD activities during any 3-year period and must be certified by each professional organization and /or PTC.
- 5. Code of Ethics (Form 7)
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 6. Professional Organization's (EPO) Endorsement signed by the National President
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
- 7. Letter of Intent addressed to the PTC President
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 8. Certificate of Good Standing from the Accredited National APO and Member of PTC
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Accredited National APO - Accredited National
APO)
- 9. Diploma (Undergraduate and Graduate Engineering)
(1) Certified True Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 10. Curriculum Vitae
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 11. Personal Details (Form 2)
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 12. Seven Years Professional Experience (Form 3)
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 13. Two (2) years Professional Experience (Form 4)
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 14. Engineering Practice Report (Form 5)
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 15. Notarized copy of Applicant's Declaration (Form 8)
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 16. Flash Drive
(Sample: 1 piece 1GB as long as it contains all application documents) (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Soft copies of the complete application documents must be saved in a single file in 1 flash drive

chunk_description: Refers to the process that provides the steps in application for renewal of Professional Identification Card (PIC).
retrieval_text:
APPLICATION FOR RENEWAL OF PROFESSIONAL IDENTIFICATION CARD (PIC)
Refers to the process that provides the steps in application for renewal of Professional Identification Card (PIC).
Who may avail: Registered Professional whose Professional Identification Card is already expired or will expire in less than one (1) year; Have no criminal record or never been convicted in a final judgment by any court, military tribunal or administrative body.
full_entry_text:
APPLICATION FOR RENEWAL OF PROFESSIONAL IDENTIFICATION CARD (PIC)
Refers to the process that provides the steps in application for renewal of Professional Identification Card (PIC).

Office/Division: Regional Office - Licensure and Registration Division
Classification: Simple
Type of Transaction: G2C (Government to Citizen)
Who may avail: Registered Professional whose Professional Identification Card is already expired or will expire in less than one (1) year; Have no criminal record or never been convicted in a final judgment by any court, military tribunal or administrative body.
Operating Hours: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Standard Requirements:
- 1. Proof of system-generated application form for the renewal of Professional Identification
Card.
(1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Professional Regulation Commission -
Regional Office - Licensure and Registration
Division (Registration Section))
  Note: Remarks:
The application form is generated online through online.prc.gov.ph.
- 2. Certificate of Attendance to accredited Continuing Professional Development (CPD)
seminars.
(1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
  Note: Remarks:
Certificate of Attendance is validated through the CPD Accreditation System (CPDAS) or screenshots from professional’s CPDAS Account
showing his/her earned CPD credit units, otherwise sign CPD undertaking.
- 3. Other documents as may be prescribed by the Professional Regulatory Law of the
concerned profession i.e. Certificate of Good Standing for Criminologists, Interior Designers,
and Pharmacists, Surety Bond for Real Estate.
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)

Situational Requirements:
[A. For Overseas Filipino Professionals (OFPs), in lieu of CPD Certificates]
[A.1. For Overseas Filipino Professionals (OFPs), in lieu of CPD Certificates
Any of the following:]
- A.1.A. Overseas Employment Certificate (OEC)
(1) Original Copy Or (1) Photo Copy Or (1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Department of Migrant Workers - Overseas
Employment Certificate Processing / Balik-
Manggagawa Unit)

(1) Original Copy Or (1) Photo Copy Or (1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)

(1) Original Copy Or (1) Photo Copy Or (1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
[A.1.D. Company Identification Card (foreign company)
Company Identification Card]
- A.1.E. Residence permit/permit to stay in a foreign country;
(1) Original Copy Or (1) Photo Copy Or (1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- A.1.F. Other credible proof/s of identity or status as OFP Overseas Filipino Professionals
(1) Original Copy Or (1) Photo Copy Or (1) Electronic Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
[B. 2A former Filipino professional who has reacquired Philippine citizenship]
- B.1. Certificate of Re-acquisition/Retention of Philippine Citizenship (CRPC)
(1) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Bureau of Immigration - Citizenship Retention
and Re-acquisition Unit (CRAU))
- B.2. Copy of new Oath Form (Panunumpa ng Propesyonal)
(1) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Professional Regulation Commission -
Regional Office - Licensure and Registration
Division (Registration Section))
  Note: Remarks:
The New Oath Form may be downloaded online through online.prc.gov.ph.
[C. For professional with dual citizenship]
[C.1. For professional with dual citizenship
Any of the following:]
- C.1.A. Proof of Philippine citizenship (i.e. valid Philippine passport)
(1) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Department of Foreign Affairs - Office of
Consular Affairs)
- C.1.B. Oath of Allegiance from the Philippine Consulate and Identification Certificate of
Philippine Citizenship;
(1) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Bureau of Immigration - Citizenship Retention
and Re-acquisition Unit (CRAU))
- C.1.C. Certificate of Retention or Re-acquisition
(1) Photo Copy (Where to secure: Bureau of Immigration - Citizenship Retention
and Re-acquisition Unit (CRAU))
[D. Requirements for Representatives]
[Sub Situational Requirement/s]
[D.a. 1. If representative is a non-registered professional]
[D.a.1. Any valid government-issued ID
Any valid government-issued ID]
- D.a.2. Special Power of Attorney (SPA) duly executed individually by the applicant.
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
[D.b. If representative is a registered professional]
[D.b.1. Valid Professional Identification Card (PIC) / Electronic-PIC
Professional Identification Card/e-PIC - Professional Regulation Commission]
- D.b.2. Original authorization letter duly signed by the applicant.
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)

full_entry_text:
APPLICATION FOR REGISTRATION WITHOUT EXAMINATION (WALK-IN) (FOR FILIPINO CITIZENS)
Refers to the process of admitting qualified applicants for registration without licensure examination upon evaluation that they complied with the qualification requirements under Republic Act (RA) No. 8981 and relevant Professional Regulatory Law (PRL).

Office/Division: Licensure Office - Licensure Division
Classification: Highly Technical
Type of Transaction: G2C (Government to Citizen)
Who may avail: Applicants who meet the following qualifications: Filipino citizen with appropriate degree as required by the specific Professional Regulatory Law (PRL) and other qualification or eligibility/legal requirements as prescribed in the PRL
Operating Hours: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Standard Requirements:
- 1. Duly accomplished Application Form for Without Examination
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Professional Regulation Commission -
Regional Office-Licensure and Registration
Division-Application Section)
- 2. One (1) Original and a photocopy of official transcript of records (TOR) with remarks: “For
PRC Purposes Only”, bearing the exact date of graduation and special order number.
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 3. One (1) original and a photocopy of PSA issued birth certificate. If PSA issued birth
Certificate is not readable, submit a clear copy of Form 102 from the Local Civil Registrar
(LCR).
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) - /LCR -
Civil Registration Services)
- 4. One (1) Original and a photocopy of PSA issued marriage certificate (MC) (for married
female applicant) and a clear copy of Form 3A from the LCR if PSA issued MC is not readable.
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) - / Civil
Registration Services)
- 5. One (1) 1.5” x 1.5” picture in white background and in decent attire taken within the last six
(6) months
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 6. Documentary Stamp Tax (DST/e-DST) per copy with Php50.00 face value
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) - District
Office)

Situational Requirements:
[A. For a Filipino citizen who finished his/her degree/course abroad, shall submit]
- A.1. Certificate of Equivalency
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Commission on Higher Education - City of
Programs and Standards Development)
[B. For those born abroad, with non-Filipino parent, with dual citizenships or recognized Filipino citizens, any of the following shall be
submitted:]
- B.1. Identification certificate
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Bureau of Immigration or Department of
Foreign Affairs - (BI) or (DFA))
- B.2. Oath of Allegiance
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Philippine Consular Office - PCO)
- B.3. Photocopy of valid Philippine passport
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Department of Foreign Affairs - DFA)
- B.4. Philippine Voter's certificate or Voter's Identification Card
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Commission on Elections - COMELEC)
[C. For additional documentary requirements, refer to the list of requirements per profession as prescribed by the concerned
Professional Regulatory Board (PRB) posted in the website]
- C.1. https://www.prc.gov.ph/list-of-requirements
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: PRC - PRBs)

full_entry_text:
APPLICATION FOR THE PROFESSIONAL ELECTRONICS ENGINEERS (PECE) ORAL EXAMINATION
The Professional Electronics Engineer (PECE) is the highest category among the Electronics Engineering practitioners. This transaction covers the filing and processing of applications for the PECE Oral Examination.

Office/Division: Licensure Office-Licensure Division (LO-LD)
Classification: Simple
Type of Transaction: G2C (Government to Citizen)
Who may avail: Qualified PECE Applicant
Operating Hours: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Standard Requirements:
- 1. Letter of Intent
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 2. Resume with passport size picture and white background
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 3. Valid PRC Professional Identification Card (PIC) and Certificate of Registration (COR) as
Electronics Engineer
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Professional Regulation Commission - RO-LRD
(Registration Section))
- 4. Valid/current membership identification card from the Accredited Professional Organization
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 5. Certified experience record of active self-practice and/or employment either in government
service or in private sector totaling seven (7) years of practice and at least two (2) years of
which are in responsible charge of significant engineering work
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 6. Essay not less than three hundred (300) words describing the two (2) years significant of
engineering work with emphasis on the involvement in the "independent responsible in-
charge" of project or work highlighted with proofs such engineering design or conceptual
plans, implementation report, project proposal, or complected project report, etc.
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 7. Three (3) certifications signed by three (3) PECEs attesting that the experience record
submitted by the applicant is factual (not needed for those who have been registered and
licensed as ECE under R.A. 5734, for at least seven (7) years.
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 8. Copy of Diploma
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
- 9. Original valid National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Clearance
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: NBI - Clearance Center)
- 10. Original valid Ombudsman Clearance (for those in the government service)
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Office of the Ombudsman - Office of the
Ombudsman)
- 11. Applicant Declaration
(1) Original Copy (Where to secure: Applicant / Client)
